steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In October 2020, Equity Mates described Electronic Arts as a major AAA games maker within the gaming ecosystem, grouping it with the largest publishers in the industry.

episode.title: Industry Deep Dive: Video Game Industry

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In June 2021, Equity Mates highlighted Electronic Arts as widely disliked and famous for in‑game loot boxes, reflecting its focus on monetising through microtransactions.

In October 2020, Equity Mates noted Electronic Arts had been voted a most hated company for loot boxes, but said it was early to the microtransaction model that became widely accepted, supporting ongoing revenue for companies using it.
